overview: SareeMart is a modern C2C marketplace for buying and selling second-hand sarees, clothing, electronics, furniture, and more — inspired by OLX.
features: Home page with featured listings and category grid
Internet Identity login and user profiles
Sell items with multi-image upload and rich details
Browse listings in a responsive grid layout
Product detail page with image gallery and seller contact
Search and filters by keyword, category, price, and location
Dark mode support and fully responsive design
